newsitem.title: UK: GKN Westland buys Aerospace Composite Tech.
newsitem.headline: GKN Westland buys Aerospace Composite Tech.

text.p: British engineering group GKN Plc said on Wednesday that its GKN Westland Aerospace division had purchased Aerospace Composite Technologies Ltd for 21 million stg, which would be met mainly from existing cash resources.
Aerospace Composite Technologies designs and manufactures aircraft cockpit windows for civil and military aircraft, as well as electrical anti-icing systems.
The company was part of Lucas Aerospace until 1993 when it was subject to a management buy-out. In the year to July 1996, pre-tax profits were 2.5 million stg on sales of 19.6 million.
GKN Westland Aerospace is principally engaged in the design and manufacture of aircraft structures for civil and defence aircraft and transmission systems for aircraft engines.
